free_tier.stated: No free tier. 玩具荷兰NAT2 is CNY 10.00 a year, printed '¥10.00CNY 每年'. Thirteen of the twenty-three plans on the page are at CNY 10.00 a year and the rest at CNY 15.00 to CNY 20.00 a year.

retention.stated: the page states '不支持任何形式的退款/退余额, 以及换区', that is no refund and no balance withdrawal and no region change; no deletion interval after expiry was published on the pages read

egress.terms: 1 TB a month, printed '流量 1T/月', with one free reset per ticket where there is no abuse record

interface_detail: LXC guest; the site also runs a Web SSH page and an Sshwifty client as separate menu items
tooling: any SSH client; the vendor's WHMCS client area and its own Web SSH
chaining: the cheapest machine found anywhere by a wide margin at USD 0.125 a month, with 20 forwarded ports and a /128 IPv6, for a monitoring node or a WireGuard endpoint that does not matter if it dies

limits.value: 1 TB a month, with one free reset per ticket if there is no abuse record
20 forwarded ports on the shared IPv4, printed 'IPv4 NAT(20端口)'

binding_note: 20 forwarded ports is a workable budget, but the binding constraint in practice is the vendor's own stability warning and the no-refund rule: the page says the toy products are unstable and must not host production, so the machine can vanish without recourse.

identity_cost.detail: a WHMCS account whose registration form marks first name, last name, street address, city and postcode as required and email as mandatory-verified; the phone field is present and labelled 手机号码 but is not marked required, and no national ID field exists in the form source. Payment rails could not be read, because the cart page requires a login before it lists a payment method, so the card requirement is inferred from the absence of any published rail rather than read. No ID document is requested at registration.

reliability_note: the vendor's own warning, quoted: '玩具产品稳定性较差, 请不要部署生产项目' (the toy products are relatively unstable, do not deploy production projects); it also states '不保证中国大陆地区直连' and '滥用将直接删除服务' (abuse results in immediate deletion), and that all hosts have China-mainland IPv4 weak protocols disabled
confidence_note: price, shape, port count, IPv6 prefix, traffic allowance, the stock markers and the vendor's own warnings are quoted from the group page read; the registration form fields are quoted from the form source read. Not documented: the payment rails, because the cart demands login; whether the 20 ports carry UDP, because no page read names a protocol for them; and the legal entity, which is not named anywhere read.

notes: By price this is the winner and it is not close: CNY 10.00 a year is USD 1.50 a year, which is USD 0.1249 a month at the ECB reference rate of 6.6702 CNY per USD read, for 512 MB, 1 GB of disk, 1 TB a month, 20 forwarded ports and an IPv6 /128. Three things hold it to a caveat. First, the vendor calls these 'toy' products and prints '玩具产品稳定性较差, 请不要部署生产项目' in red on every one of them, so this is not a machine to depend on. Second, there is no refund and no region change in any circumstance. Third, the stock is not shown for this plan: the page carries a stock span on ten plans all reading '0 可用' and no stock span at all on the other thirteen, which is the stock-control-off state, so whether this plan can be ordered today is unknown rather than confirmed. Registration needs a name, a street address, a city and a postcode but no phone and no national ID, which is a low identity cost by Chinese-seller standards, and it is the mainland-style address form rather than a 实名认证 gate. Payment rails could not be read at all. What would settle the row: a logged-in cart, which would show both the stock and the payment methods; and a ticket asking whether the 20 ports carry UDP.
